modelDescription: Precision, performance and price have never come together like this. Savage rebuilt the synthetic stock on the AXIS II for improved ergonomics that let any hunter shoot their very best. Like always, the rifle's user-adjustable AccuTrigger, thread-in headspacing and floating bolt head extract the utmost accuracy from the button rifled sporter barrel for the performance of high-end hunting rifles at a fraction of the price.
